nodes.label: Kin — Family Operating System
nodes.rationale: One-household, five-hub (Family, Journal, Planner, Household, Wealth) family management app implementing the 'Kin - Family App' Claude Design handoff bundle and its 'Industry' blueprint design system.

nodes.label: Supabase Backend (kin-family-app)
nodes.rationale: Supabase project kin-family-app (lffqluudphzviubygwjs, ap-southeast-1) with schema, RLS, and storage buckets applied as migrations directly via Supabase MCP tooling during the build, so there is no local supabase/ folder checked in.

nodes.label: Industry Blueprint Design System
nodes.rationale: Steel-blue, Barlow Condensed, hairline-border design system carried over from the Claude Design handoff bundle, implemented as design tokens layered into src/app/globals.css.

nodes.label: Supabase Auth 6-digit Email OTP
nodes.rationale: The onboarding 'Verify email' screen expects a 6-digit code rather than a magic link, so the Supabase 'Confirm signup' email template must include {{ .Token }}; otherwise Supabase sends a confirmation link and the code field won't work.

nodes.label: Google Drive OAuth Integration
nodes.rationale: Settings > Connected storage > Google Drive requires GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET/REDIRECT_URI and a Google Cloud OAuth client with the drive.file scope; the /api/drive/* route handlers use SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY to read/write the drive_tokens table, which RLS deliberately hides from every other role. Without config, the button explains it isn't configured instead of erroring.

nodes.label: Row-Level Security (RLS) Privacy Policies
nodes.rationale: RLS enforces per-record privacy server-side, not just in the UI: personal wealth data is visible only to its owner unless marked joint; health records and documents carry a 'Visible to' field (family/parents/just me).

nodes.label: Managed Child Profiles (no login)
nodes.rationale: Pre-literate children have no auth_user_id and no login by design; they are rows a parent edits, matching the design decision that there's no kid login in v1.

nodes.label: Sandboxed Build Verification Gap
nodes.rationale: The app was type-checked, linted, and built inside a sandboxed session whose network egress policy blocks *.supabase.co, so the signup -> Supabase Auth flow could not be exercised end-to-end there; it must be tested on a normal deployment or developer machine before shipping.
